sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-ORB1 key (RB-ORB1) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the Federal State Reserve Agency base second barracks armories.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Required for the quest Reserve Expert from Ragman

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Reserve
sections.text: - In bottom of tunnel in shower room on key case on wall next to the door

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: South barracks on Reserve. East end of the southern building, 4th floor. (Highlighted in green)

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 3 Weapon racks (AK-74N, AKS-74U, AKS-74N, AKS-74UB, AKS-74UN)
- Loose loot (Weapon mods, Ammunition)
- Two Drawers
- Intelligence folder spawn on ground
